name: aurelis-store
description: AURELIS: React + TypeScript frontend and Go + Gin API

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && cd backend && go build -o bin/server ./cmd/server
scripts.check: npm run build --prefix frontend && cd backend && go vet ./...
scripts.format: npm exec --prefix frontend -- prettier --write 'frontend/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}' && cd backend && gofmt -w cmd internal
